newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pete's Brewing EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pete's Brewing EPS cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it cut earnings and revenue estimates for Pete's Brewing Co based on the expectation of decreased shipments in the first quarter while the company re-balances inventories.
-- In a statement, H&Q said it lowered its first quarter earnings forecast to a loss of $0.05 a share from a profit of $0.01. Its full-year eatimate was cut to a profit of $0.20 a share from $0.25.
-- H&Q's first quarter revenue estimate was cut to $13 million from $14 million.
